commerce_beneficiary_venue_binding_check.name: commerce_beneficiary_venue_binding_check
commerce_beneficiary_venue_binding_check.value: ("commerce_beneficiary"."kind" = 'foundation' and "commerce_beneficiary"."venue_id" is null) or ("commerce_beneficiary"."kind" = 'venue' and "commerce_beneficiary"."venue_id" is not null)

commerce_order_snapshot_binding_check.name: commerce_order_snapshot_binding_check
commerce_order_snapshot_binding_check.value: "commerce_order_snapshot"."funding_classification" = 'legacy_unverified' or ("commerce_order_snapshot"."allocation_policy_id" is not null and "commerce_order_snapshot"."foundation_beneficiary_id" is not null and "commerce_order_snapshot"."foundation_legal_name" is not null)

finance_evidence_public_check.name: finance_evidence_public_check
finance_evidence_public_check.value: "finance_evidence"."status" not in ('published', 'withdrawn') or "finance_evidence"."public_redacted_storage_key" is not null

finance_transaction_posted_check.name: finance_transaction_posted_check
finance_transaction_posted_check.value: ("finance_transaction"."status" = 'draft' and "finance_transaction"."posted_at" is null) or ("finance_transaction"."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "finance_transaction"."posted_at" is not null)
